_comment: SIH PS 26184 — Approved Signal Architecture Configuration
_note: This config freezes the approved signal hierarchy. Equal-weight composite MUST NOT be used as primary ATM ranking classifier.

PRIMARY.description: Robust Z-Score acute velocity anomaly detector
PRIMARY.role: Primary acute ATM ranking signal. Used first to rank ATMs.

SECONDARY.description: Mule account links and unique account diversity surge

SUPPORTING.role: Supporting signal for acute velocity surges

CONTEXTUAL_EVIDENCE.description: 2-hop metro network exposure and recency decay
CONTEXTUAL_EVIDENCE.role: Contextual evidence only, not primary discriminator

CONTEXTUAL_EVIDENCE.note: Reserved for future integration when complaint geospatial data available

composite_ranking.note: Full composite risk score is used for audit/alert evidence only, not as primary ATM ranking discriminator

alert_gate.note: All thresholds are configurable operational defaults, NOT calibrated thresholds

severity_thresholds.note: Operational defaults, NOT calibrated. CRITICAL means investigator review required, NEVER autonomous intervention.

severity_definitions.MEDIUM: Minor anomaly detected; passive monitoring, no action required
severity_definitions.HIGH: Elevated multi-signal convergence; queue for investigator review
severity_definitions.CRITICAL: Investigator review required — NOT autonomous field intervention

replay_simulator.causality_invariant: strict event-time causal: at timestamp T, no information from >T is accessible
